newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai, GAZ make no progress in talks.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai, GAZ make no progress in talks.

text.p: South Korea's Hyundai Motor Co said on Thursday no progress had been made so far in its joint-venture talks with Russian carmaker GAZ.
"We have seen no progress in talks with the Russian company, and talks are still going on," said a Hyundai spokesman.
The South Korean carmaker wanted to set up a venture in Russia to secure a foothold in the region, he said.
Hyundai Motor, a flagship unit of the Hyundai Group, declined to give details of its plan. But media reports have said the company planned to produce Accent and Avante compact cars in Russia.
